positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Headed the cloud solutions development team, effectively driving project and task planning to ensure alignment with requirements and deadlines. Played an instrumental role in designing and implementing robust APIs, boosting application functionality. Performed code reviews to ensure the quality of the features being developed. 
- Spearheaded the design & development of a web application, enabling quick visualization & analysis of digital evidence. The tech stack included Vue, Kendo UI components, .NET Core, and Azure services.
- Designed and implemented a .NET Core-based platform with integrated Dapr and Azure Kubernetes Service, simplifying microservices creation for app developers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Pioneered the development of a cloud-based .NET Core application in Azure, ensuring secure communication through queue triggers & SignalR. Also introduced a user-friendly Blazor server-side admin portal using Kendo UI.
- Led extensive database research & benchmarking, focusing on Snowflake, Oracle Autonomous databases, and Azure SQL Server (Hyperscale) to augment dataset analysis capabilities

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Played a vital role in enhancing a WPF application's feature set, leveraging .NET Framework, C#, XAML, and Oracle databases. Introduced robust data visualization tools like graphs, charts, maps, and reports for comprehensive analysis.
